title: Epic Clinical Workstation Standardization & Peripheral Configuration with Microsoft Intune
author_notes: Derived from a Senior Endpoint Engineer (healthcare/Epic) requirement: configure endpoints for Epic workflows (printing, peripherals, workstation standardization).

Scope: standardize clinical Windows workstations for Epic via Intune — device baseline + context-aware printer deployment (wristband/label/script/document), default printer mapping, scanners, signature pads, badge readers. Epic-internal print values deferred to Epic TS/UserWeb. White-label.
pricing: T3 (advanced) — multi-component standardization + peripheral/printing within one platform.
